capabilities: create custom groups of ribbon icons
assign custom SVG icons to groups
show hover-to-expand popup menus with animations and blur
display hotkey badges inside popup menus
disambiguation: Despite its name, it modifies the ribbon (the icon strip), not the sidebar panels themselves.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation is provided in English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
problem: Plugin icons accumulating on the Obsidian ribbon clutter the interface, with no built-in way to group them.
summary: Ribbon organizer that groups sidebar icons into hover-to-expand popup menus with custom icons, animations, and hotkey badges.
